text: Prediction markets move first. Memecoins follow.
When the crowd's odds on a real-world story suddenly jump, the memes named after that story often move hours later.
Oddshot is a PayBox plugin, so your agent in Claude, ChatGPT or Grok can catch that window.
Here it is, running on PayBox. One call to Oddshot play scans the biggest Polymarket swings, finds the Solana meme riding each story, and labels the timing.
The top play: odds on the GTA 6 trailer jumped twenty-nine points, and the GTA 6 token hasn't moved. That gap is the window.
And when a story spawns a swarm of copycats, Oddshot crowns the OG. For GTA 6: thirty-five tokens, twenty-two copycats skipped, and a frenzy warning.
Before you ape, every token is cross-checked against three sources: market data, RugCheck, and Jupiter's audit.
RugCheck alone rates this token good. But Jupiter shows its developer has launched over eight thousand tokens. So Oddshot flags it yellow.
And when a token is red, like one with live mint authority, the buy is refused. Exits are never blocked.
Here's the real thing, inside Claude. Oddshot builds a capped swap, and PayBox opens its transaction window. You approve, and it's confirmed on Solana.
Did the call age well? Oddshot flagged GTA 6 as early at 5:44 PM. Seven hours later, it's up twenty percent, and reverse mode shows the odds kept climbing.
And bag check scans any wallet, flagging dead tokens to exit before they cost you.
Oddshot passed PayBox's hosted checks with all seven tools, and it's live in PayBox today.
Oddshot. The odds moved. The memes haven't. Yet.
